en.charge_mode_hint_solar_only_surplus: Only the solar surplus left over after the house. Never imports grid.
en.charge_mode_hint_solar_only_battery: Untouched — discharges only for the house, never for EV.
en.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_surplu: Solar surplus only. Paused during expensive tariff windows.
en.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_overni: Charges during the cheapest tariff hours only.
en.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_batter: Untouched — discharges only for the house, never for EV.
en.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_surplus: Guarantees the Min current using solar + battery + grid; rides surplus up to Max.
en.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_overnigh: Tops up at Min current until the Min target is reached.
en.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_battery: Drains for EV when home battery SOC ≥ {buffer}% (buffer). Below {buffer}% the home battery is protected from EV draw. Below {priority}% (priority floor) EV charging idles entirely.
en.charge_mode_hint_always_max_surplus: Charges at hardware max — solar is consumed first, then the home battery (per zones), then grid backfills the rest.
en.charge_mode_hint_always_max_overnight: Charges at hardware max from grid + home battery.
en.charge_mode_hint_always_max_battery: Drains whenever total home demand exceeds solar, down to {buffer}% (buffer SOC). Protected below buffer.
en.zone_help_autostart: Above this SOC, the home battery automatically helps the EV in min_plus_solar daytime.
en.zone_help_buffer: Battery is protected from EV draw below this SOC; solar still recharges it normally.
en.zone_help_floor: Lowest SOC the battery will discharge to while assisting the EV.
en.zone_help_assist_min_surplus: Minimum real solar surplus before the home battery helps charge the EV — in any mode. Below this the battery is reserved for the house. 0 = battery supports the EV everywhere, including overnight.
en.zone_help_assist_max_power: Maximum power the home battery may discharge to assist EV charging when above the assist floor.
en.zone_help_priority: Critical reserve. Below this, all solar goes to the battery and EV charging idles.
en.tile_help_start_amps: Initial ramp current when a session starts (soft start).
en.tile_help_min_amps: SEM-side floor — minimum current SEM ever commands.
en.tile_help_vehicle_min_amps: Per-car handshake floor — set higher if your car ignores 6 A offers.
en.tile_help_capacity: Battery pack size — drives SOC estimation and range calculations.
en.tile_help_consumption: Average consumption used to estimate driving range from SOC.
en.setting_help_priority_soc: Below this SOC, the home battery has absolute priority — no EV charging at all.
en.setting_help_minimum_soc: Hard discharge stop — SEM halts EV draw if the battery falls below this (safety).
en.setting_help_resume_soc: Battery must reach this SOC for EV assist to resume after a stop.
en.setting_help_cheap_threshold: Below this rate the price is classified as 'cheap' — enables solar_plus_cheap night charging windows.
en.setting_help_expensive_threshold: Above this rate the price is 'expensive' — solar_plus_cheap pauses during these hours.
en.config_tab_subtitle: Tune SEM without leaving the dashboard
en.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
en.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.
en.config_tariff_manage: Tariff entity & mode in HA settings
en.config_heat_pump_manage: Heat pump entities in HA settings
en.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
en.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
en.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
en.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
en.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
en.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
en.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
en.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
en.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
en.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Solar surplus must persist this many seconds before a surplus charge starts. Prevents a single sun spike from closing the contactor.
en.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Deficit must persist this many seconds before a surplus charge stops; meanwhile the charger holds its minimum current. Protects the contactor from cloud-flicker on/off cycling.
en.onboarding_banner_title: New: configure SEM from the dashboard
en.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
en.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
en.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
en.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
en.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
en.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
en.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
en.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
en.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
en.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
en.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
en.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Optional sensor holding your live export (feed-in) price — e.g. your Tibber export-price sensor or a template like spot minus margin. When set, it overrides the flat Export rate so export revenue follows the market hour by hour.
en.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
en.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
en.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
en.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid. For a dynamic/spot contract (e.g. Tibber) this is the spot price minus your provider margin — set a flat average here, or use the Feed-in entity below for live tracking. Leave it set so export revenue and ROI are calculated.
en.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
en.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
en.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
en.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
en.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
en.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
en.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
en.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
en.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
en.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
en.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
en.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
en.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
en.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
en.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
en.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
en.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
en.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
en.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
en.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
en.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
en.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
en.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
en.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
en.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
en.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
en.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
en.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
en.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
en.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
en.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
en.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
en.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
en.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
en.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
en.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
en.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
en.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
en.tile_help_max_grid_import: Maximum power SEM may import from the grid to run surplus devices.
en.tile_help_surplus_priority: Order this charger gets solar surplus across the fleet (lower = charges first).
en.tile_help_shed_priority: Order this charger is throttled when grid import nears the peak limit (higher = shed first).
en.reset_sign_detection_help: Clears the learned grid/battery power sign and re-learns it. Use if import/export (or charge/discharge) appears inverted. Trigger it while the system is clearly exporting/importing for a clean re-learn.
en.fix_grid_sign_help: Flips grid import/export if it looks inverted and copies a ready-to-paste report to your clipboard. Paste it into a GitHub issue so we can improve auto-detection for your meter.
en.sign_flipped_copied: Sign flipped — report copied to clipboard
en.sign_flipped: Sign flipped — clipboard blocked, copy the report from the logs
en.config_battery_arbitrage_enable: Sell battery to grid on high export
en.config_help_battery_arbitrage: When the dynamic export price is high enough to beat the cost of recharging later, discharge the battery to the grid to sell stored energy. Opt-in; never discharges below the reserve SOC.
en.config_help_arbitrage_min_export: Only sell battery energy to the grid when the export price is at least this much per kWh.
en.config_help_arbitrage_reserve_soc: Never discharge the battery to the grid below this SOC — your backup reserve.
en.config_help_force_discharge_entity: The number entity that sets your inverter’s forcible battery-to-grid discharge power (e.g. the Huawei “Forcible discharge power”). Required for arbitrage to actuate.
en.battery_mode_hint_auto: Auto: SEM charges from solar surplus, powers the house, and follows the schedule.
en.battery_mode_hint_self_consumption: Charges from surplus and powers the house — never sells to the grid.
en.battery_mode_hint_force_charge: Charging to full now, regardless of price or surplus.
en.battery_mode_hint_force_discharge: Discharging to the grid now, down to the reserve SOC.
en.battery_mode_hint_off: SEM stays hands-off — the inverter manages this battery on its own.
en.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
en.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

de.zone_help_buffer: Batterie ist unter diesem SOC vor EV-Entnahme geschützt; Solar lädt weiter normal nach.
de.zone_help_floor: Niedrigster SOC, bis zu dem die Batterie das EV unterstützt.
de.zone_help_assist_min_surplus: Mindest-Solarüberschuss, bevor die Hausbatterie das E-Auto lädt — in jedem Modus. Darunter bleibt die Batterie dem Haus vorbehalten. 0 = Batterie unterstützt das E-Auto überall, auch nachts.
de.zone_help_assist_max_power: Maximale Leistung, mit der die Hausbatterie das EV-Laden oberhalb der Unterstützungsgrenze unterstützt.
de.zone_help_priority: Kritische Reserve. Darunter geht aller Solarertrag in die Batterie, EV-Laden pausiert.
de.tile_help_min_amps: SEM-Untergrenze — niedrigster Strom, den SEM jemals befiehlt.
de.tile_help_vehicle_min_amps: Pro-Auto-Handshake-Untergrenze — höher setzen, falls dein Auto 6 A ignoriert.
de.tile_help_capacity: Batteriegröße — Basis für SoC-Schätzung und Reichweitenberechnung.
de.tile_help_consumption: Durchschnittsverbrauch zur Reichweitenschätzung aus dem SoC.
de.setting_help_priority_soc: Unter diesem SOC hat die Hausbatterie absolute Priorität — kein EV-Laden.
de.setting_help_minimum_soc: Harter Entladestopp — SEM stoppt EV-Entnahme, wenn die Batterie darunter fällt (Sicherheit).
de.setting_help_resume_soc: Batterie muss diesen SOC erreichen, damit EV-Unterstützung nach Stopp fortgesetzt wird.
de.setting_help_cheap_threshold: Unter diesem Tarif gilt der Preis als 'günstig' — aktiviert solar_plus_cheap-Nachtfenster.
de.setting_help_expensive_threshold: Über diesem Tarif gilt der Preis als 'teuer' — solar_plus_cheap pausiert in diesen Stunden.
de.config_tab_subtitle: SEM ohne Verlassen des Dashboards anpassen
de.config_overview_help: Alles unten ist direkt änderbar. HA-Einstellungen nur öffnen, wenn ein Bereich den benötigten Entity-Picker noch nicht hat.
de.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV-Ladestationen werden über die HA-Einstellungen hinzugefügt, damit SEM ihre Entities registrieren kann. Danach hier feinjustieren.
de.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Vorhersage-gesteuerte Nacht-Ladepläne. Kapazität, max. Ladeleistung und Roundtrip-Effizienz in den HA-Einstellungen konfigurieren — Ziele werden automatisch angepasst.
de.config_forecast_install_hint: Forecast.Solar oder Solcast in HA installieren, um vorhersagebasierte Planung zu aktivieren.
de.config_notifications_intro: SEM sendet Push-Benachrichtigungen über deine mobile_app-Integration. Ereignisse und Empfänger in HA-Einstellungen wählen.
de.config_help_observer_mode: Nur-Lese-Modus: SEM beobachtet, sendet aber keine Befehle. Sicher zum Lernen des Systems.
de.config_help_update_interval: Sekunden zwischen Coordinator-Zyklen. Niedriger = reaktiver, höher = weniger Last für HA. 30 s ist der Sweet Spot.
de.config_help_power_delta: Minimaler Leistungs-Schwankung (W), bevor SEM reagiert. Filtert Solar-/Last-Jitter.
de.config_help_current_delta: Minimale Stromänderung, bevor SEM die Ladestation neu ansteuert. Vermeidet Mikro-Anpassungen.
de.config_help_soc_delta: Minimale SOC-Änderung (%), bevor SEM einen neuen Zustand annimmt.
de.config_help_min_solar_power: Unterhalb dieser Solar-Leistung (W) stoppt SEM die Überschuss-Ladung — winzige PV liegt unter der Rauschgrenze.
de.config_help_ev_enable_delay: So viele Sekunden muss der Solar-Überschuss anstehen, bevor eine Überschussladung startet. Verhindert, dass eine einzelne Sonnenspitze den Schütz schließt.
de.config_help_ev_disable_delay: So viele Sekunden muss das Defizit anstehen, bevor eine Überschussladung stoppt; solange hält die Ladestation ihren Mindeststrom. Schützt den Schütz vor Ein/Aus-Zyklen bei Wolkenflackern.
de.onboarding_banner_title: Neu: SEM direkt im Dashboard konfigurieren
de.onboarding_banner_body: Der Konfigurations-Tab macht jede Einstellung einen Klick entfernt — kein Wühlen mehr in Einstellungen → Geräte & Dienste.
de.config_heat_pump_intro: Wähle die Relais/Klima-Entity, die deine Wärmepumpe ansteuern. Änderungen werden sofort gespeichert — SEM erkennt die Wärmepumpe automatisch.
de.config_help_hp_relay: Für SG-Ready: beide Relais müssen gesetzt sein. Überspringen, wenn deine Wärmepumpe nur eine Klima-Entity hat.
de.config_help_hp_climate: Für reine Klima-Steuerung (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM hebt den Sollwert um boost_offset °C, wenn Überschuss verfügbar ist.
de.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lässt SEM den Wärmepumpe-Verbrauch in Lasttracking und Ersparnis einbeziehen.
de.config_help_hp_boost_offset: Wie viele °C über dem Nutzer-Sollwert SEM das Klima-Ziel anhebt, wenn Überschuss da ist.
de.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute Obergrenze für den Klima-Sollwert — SEM überschreitet das auch bei viel Überschuss nicht.
de.config_help_hp_priority: Niedriger = höhere Priorität. EV bekommt meist 1-3, Wärmepumpe 4-6, Pool 7-10.
de.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
de.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
de.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
de.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Optionaler Sensor mit deinem aktuellen Einspeisepreis — z. B. dein Tibber-Einspeisesensor oder ein Template wie Spot minus Marge. Wenn gesetzt, überschreibt er die feste Einspeisevergütung, sodass der Erlös dem Markt stündlich folgt.
de.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
de.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
de.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
de.config_help_export_rate: Vergütung pro kWh bei Einspeisung ins Netz. Bei einem dynamischen/Spot-Tarif (z. B. Tibber) ist das der Spotpreis abzüglich Anbietermarge — hier einen festen Durchschnitt eintragen oder unten die Einspeise-Entität für Live-Tracking nutzen. Gesetzt lassen, damit Einspeiseerlös und ROI berechnet werden.
de.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
de.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
de.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
de.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
de.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
de.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
de.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
de.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
de.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
de.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
de.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
de.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
de.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
de.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
de.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
de.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
de.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
de.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
de.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
de.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
de.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
de.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
de.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
de.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
de.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
de.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
de.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
de.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh-Modus (Standard): SEM lädt bis das tägliche kWh-Ziel erreicht ist. SOC-Modus: SEM lädt bis die Fahrzeug-SOC das Ziel erreicht — nur verfügbar, wenn oben ein Fahrzeug-SOC-Sensor konfiguriert ist.
de.config_hot_water_intro: Konfiguriere deinen Warmwasserboiler, damit SEM ihn bei Solarüberschuss aktiviert und einen periodischen Legionellenzyklus fahren kann.
de.config_help_hw_entity: Ein Schalter oder water_heater, den SEM ein-/ausschalten kann. Erforderlich.
de.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. Wenn konfiguriert, blockiert SEM weiteres Heizen sobald die Temperatur das aktive Ziel erreicht. Leer lassen um nur dem internen Thermostat des Boilers zu vertrauen.
de.config_help_hw_solar_target: Ziel-Temperatur für Solar-Boost. SEM stoppt die Aktivierung bei Überschuss sobald das Wasser diese erreicht.
de.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware-Sicherheitsobergrenze. SEM aktiviert nie über diesem Wert, unabhängig vom Modus.
de.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Zieltemperatur für den periodischen Legionellen-Sterilisationszyklus. Typischerweise 60–65 °C.
de.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Darunter erzwingt SEM Heizen aus beliebiger Quelle (nicht nur Solar), um nutzbares Warmwasser sicherzustellen.
de.config_help_hw_priority: Priorität für Überschussverteilung. Niedrigere Zahlen werden zuerst bedient. 1 = höchste Priorität.
de.tile_help_max_grid_import: Maximale Netzleistung, die SEM zum Betrieb von Überschuss-Geräten beziehen darf.
de.tile_help_surplus_priority: Reihenfolge bei der Solarüberschuss-Verteilung in der Flotte (niedriger = lädt zuerst).
de.tile_help_shed_priority: Reihenfolge beim Drosseln bei Netzspitze (höher = zuerst abgeworfen).
de.reset_sign_detection_help: Setzt das gelernte Netz-/Batterie-Vorzeichen zurück und lernt es neu. Nutzen, wenn Bezug/Einspeisung (oder Laden/Entladen) vertauscht erscheint. Bei klarer Einspeisung/Bezug auslösen für sauberes Neulernen.
de.fix_grid_sign_help: Kehrt Netz-Import/Export um, falls vertauscht, und kopiert einen fertigen Bericht in die Zwischenablage. Füge ihn in ein GitHub-Issue ein, damit wir die automatische Erkennung für deinen Zähler verbessern können.
de.sign_flipped_copied: Vorzeichen umgekehrt – Bericht in Zwischenablage kopiert
de.sign_flipped: Vorzeichen umgekehrt – Zwischenablage blockiert, Bericht aus dem Log kopieren
de.config_battery_arbitrage_enable: Batterie bei hohem Export ins Netz verkaufen
de.config_help_battery_arbitrage: Wenn der dynamische Einspeisepreis hoch genug ist, um die spätere Nachladekosten zu übertreffen, wird die Batterie zum Verkauf ins Netz entladen. Optional; entlädt nie unter den Reserve-SOC.
de.config_help_arbitrage_min_export: Batterie nur ins Netz verkaufen, wenn der Einspeisepreis mindestens so hoch pro kWh ist.
de.config_help_arbitrage_reserve_soc: Batterie nie unter diesen SOC ins Netz entladen — deine Notreserve.
de.config_help_force_discharge_entity: Die Number-Entität, die die erzwungene Batterie-ins-Netz-Entladeleistung deines Wechselrichters setzt (z. B. Huawei „Erzwungene Entladeleistung“). Für die Arbitrage erforderlich.
de.battery_mode_hint_auto: Auto: SEM lädt aus Solarüberschuss, versorgt das Haus und folgt dem Zeitplan.
de.battery_mode_hint_self_consumption: Lädt aus Überschuss und versorgt das Haus — speist nie ins Netz ein.
de.battery_mode_hint_force_charge: Lädt jetzt voll, unabhängig von Preis oder Überschuss.
de.battery_mode_hint_force_discharge: Entlädt jetzt ins Netz, bis zum Reserve-SOC.
de.battery_mode_hint_off: SEM greift nicht ein — der Wechselrichter steuert diese Batterie selbst.
de.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Aktivieren, wenn die Entladeleistungs-Entität dieser Batterie ein bidirektionaler Sollwert ist – eine Number-Entität für Laden und Entladen, z. B. Sessy. SEM lädt dann durch Schreiben eines negativen Werts. Für eine einseitige Zwangsentlade-Entität (z. B. Huawei) aus lassen.
de.config_help_strategy_entity: Die Select-Entität, die die Leistungsstrategie der Batterie setzt (z. B. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM schaltet sie auf den API-/Aktiv-Wert, während es den Sollwert steuert, und stellt danach Ihren Normalmodus (nom/roi/eco) wieder her. Für AC-gekoppelte Batterien wie Sessy; sonst leer lassen.

fr.requires_tooltip: S'active uniquement quand l'appareil sélectionné fonctionne
fr.mode_tooltip: OFF = jamais touché. Pic seul = délestage lors des pics réseau. Surplus = marche/arrêt auto avec le solaire.

fr.mapping_service_required: Veuillez saisir un service (p. ex. keba.set_current).

fr.ev_tariff_hint: Aux heures les moins chères ; recharge réseau en pause si cher
fr.plan_strip_title: Plan du jour · 12 h à venir
fr.plan_strip_help: Aperçu de ce que cette borne fera dans les 12 prochaines heures : gris = inactif, violet = attente d'une heure de tarif moins chère, vert = en charge, turquoise = objectif atteint. La fine ligne du haut marque les fenêtres tarifaires bon marché (vert) et chères (rose).
fr.charge_mode_hint_solar_only_surplus: Uniquement le surplus solaire restant après la maison. Jamais d'import réseau.
fr.charge_mode_hint_solar_only_battery: Intacte — se décharge uniquement pour la maison, jamais pour le VE.
fr.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_surplu: Surplus solaire uniquement. En pause durant les heures chères.
fr.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_overni: Charge uniquement dans les heures les moins chères.
fr.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_batter: Intacte — se décharge uniquement pour la maison, jamais pour le VE.
fr.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_surplus: Garantit le courant Min via solaire + batterie + réseau ; utilise le surplus jusqu'au Max.
fr.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_overnigh: Complète au courant Min jusqu'à l'atteinte de la cible Min.
fr.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_battery: Se décharge pour le VE quand la batterie maison ≥ {buffer}% (tampon). En dessous de {buffer}% elle est protégée du tirage VE. En dessous de {priority}% (seuil prioritaire) la charge VE est suspendue.
fr.charge_mode_hint_always_max_surplus: Charge au maximum matériel — solaire d'abord, puis batterie maison (par zone), puis le réseau complète.
fr.charge_mode_hint_always_max_overnight: Charge au maximum matériel depuis réseau + batterie maison.
fr.charge_mode_hint_always_max_battery: Se décharge dès que la demande maison dépasse le solaire, jusqu'à {buffer}% (SoC tampon). Protégée en dessous.
fr.heat_pump_not_configured: Aucune pompe à chaleur configurée — définissez les relais (SG-Ready) ou une entité climate (climate-only) dans Paramètres → SEM → Pompe à chaleur.
fr.zone_help_autostart: Au-dessus de ce SoC, la batterie maison aide automatiquement le VE en journée en min_plus_solar.
fr.zone_help_buffer: La batterie est protégée du tirage VE en dessous de ce SoC ; le solaire la recharge normalement.
fr.zone_help_floor: SoC le plus bas auquel la batterie se déchargera en assistant le VE.
fr.zone_help_priority: Réserve critique. En dessous, tout le solaire va à la batterie et la charge VE est suspendue.
fr.tile_help_start_amps: Courant initial au démarrage d'une session (démarrage doux).
fr.tile_help_min_amps: Plancher côté SEM — courant minimal jamais commandé.
fr.tile_help_vehicle_min_amps: Plancher de handshake par véhicule — augmentez si votre voiture ignore 6 A.
fr.tile_help_capacity: Taille du pack batterie — base pour l'estimation du SoC et l'autonomie.
fr.tile_help_consumption: Consommation moyenne pour estimer l'autonomie depuis le SoC.
fr.setting_help_priority_soc: Sous ce SoC, la batterie maison a priorité absolue — pas de charge VE.
fr.setting_help_minimum_soc: Arrêt strict de décharge — SEM stoppe le tirage VE si la batterie passe sous ce seuil (sécurité).
fr.setting_help_resume_soc: La batterie doit atteindre ce SoC pour que l'assistance VE reprenne après un arrêt.
fr.setting_help_cheap_threshold: En dessous de ce tarif, le prix est classé 'pas cher' — active les fenêtres nuit solar_plus_cheap.
fr.setting_help_expensive_threshold: Au-dessus de ce tarif, le prix est 'cher' — solar_plus_cheap se met en pause à ces heures.
fr.config_tab_subtitle: Tune SEM without leaving the dashboard
fr.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
fr.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.
fr.config_tariff_manage: Tariff entity & mode in HA settings
fr.config_heat_pump_manage: Heat pump entities in HA settings
fr.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
fr.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
fr.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
fr.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
fr.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
fr.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
fr.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
fr.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
fr.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
fr.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Le surplus solaire doit persister ce nombre de secondes avant qu'une charge sur surplus démarre. Évite qu'un pic de soleil isolé ferme le contacteur.
fr.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Le déficit doit persister ce nombre de secondes avant qu'une charge sur surplus s'arrête ; entre-temps la borne maintient son courant minimal. Protège le contacteur des cycles marche/arrêt dus aux passages nuageux.
fr.onboarding_banner_title: New: configure SEM from the dashboard
fr.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
fr.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
fr.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
fr.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
fr.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
fr.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
fr.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
fr.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
fr.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
fr.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
fr.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
fr.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
fr.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
fr.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
fr.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
fr.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
fr.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
fr.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
fr.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
fr.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
fr.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
fr.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
fr.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
fr.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
fr.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
fr.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
fr.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
fr.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
fr.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
fr.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
fr.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
fr.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
fr.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
fr.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
fr.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
fr.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
fr.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
fr.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
fr.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
fr.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
fr.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
fr.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
fr.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
fr.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
fr.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
fr.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
fr.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
fr.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
fr.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
fr.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
fr.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
fr.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
fr.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
fr.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
fr.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
fr.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

it.config_tab_subtitle: Tune SEM without leaving the dashboard
it.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
it.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.
it.config_tariff_manage: Tariff entity & mode in HA settings
it.config_heat_pump_manage: Heat pump entities in HA settings
it.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
it.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
it.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
it.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
it.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
it.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
it.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
it.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
it.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
it.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Il surplus solare deve persistere per questi secondi prima che parta una carica da surplus. Evita che un singolo picco di sole chiuda il contattore.
it.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Il deficit deve persistere per questi secondi prima che una carica da surplus si fermi; nel frattempo la colonnina mantiene la corrente minima. Protegge il contattore dai cicli on/off dovuti alle nuvole.
it.onboarding_banner_title: New: configure SEM from the dashboard
it.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
it.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
it.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
it.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
it.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
it.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
it.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
it.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
it.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
it.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
it.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
it.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
it.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
it.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
it.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
it.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
it.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
it.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
it.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
it.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
it.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
it.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
it.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
it.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
it.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
it.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
it.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
it.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
it.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
it.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
it.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
it.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
it.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
it.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
it.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
it.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
it.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
it.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
it.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
it.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
it.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
it.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
it.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
it.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
it.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
it.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
it.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
it.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
it.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
it.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
it.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
it.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
it.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
it.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
it.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
it.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

nl.charge_mode_hint_solar_only_battery: Ongebruikt — ontlaadt alleen voor het huis, nooit voor EV.
nl.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_surplu: Alleen zon-overschot. Gepauzeerd in dure tariefuren.
nl.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_overni: Laadt alleen in de goedkoopste tariefuren.
nl.charge_mode_hint_solar_plus_cheap_batter: Ongebruikt — ontlaadt alleen voor het huis, nooit voor EV.
nl.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_surplus: Garandeert de Min-stroom uit zon + batterij + net; benut overschot tot Max.
nl.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_overnigh: Bijladen op Min-stroom tot het Min-doel bereikt is.
nl.charge_mode_hint_min_plus_solar_battery: Ontlaadt voor EV als de thuisbatterij ≥ {buffer}% (buffer) is. Onder {buffer}% is de batterij beschermd tegen EV-ontlading. Onder {priority}% (prioriteitsdrempel) pauzeert EV-laden volledig.

nl.zone_help_autostart: Boven dit SOC helpt de thuisbatterij overdag automatisch het EV bij min_plus_solar.
nl.zone_help_buffer: Batterij is beschermd tegen EV-onttrekking onder dit SOC; zon laadt normaal door.
nl.zone_help_floor: Laagste SOC waartoe de batterij zich ontlaadt bij EV-ondersteuning.
nl.zone_help_assist_min_surplus: Minimaal echt zonne-overschot voordat de thuisbatterij de EV helpt laden — in elke modus. Daaronder blijft de batterij voor het huis. 0 = batterij ondersteunt de EV overal, ook 's nachts.
nl.zone_help_assist_max_power: Maximaal vermogen waarmee de thuisbatterij het EV-laden ondersteunt boven de ondersteuningsgrens.
nl.zone_help_priority: Kritieke reserve. Daaronder gaat alle zon naar de batterij en pauzeert EV-laden.

nl.tile_help_vehicle_min_amps: Per-auto handshake-ondergrens — hoger zetten als je auto 6 A negeert.
nl.tile_help_capacity: Accupakketgrootte — basis voor SoC-schatting en bereikberekening.
nl.tile_help_consumption: Gemiddeld verbruik om bereik te schatten uit SoC.
nl.setting_help_priority_soc: Onder dit SOC heeft de thuisbatterij absolute prioriteit — geen EV-laden.
nl.setting_help_minimum_soc: Harde ontlaadstop — SEM stopt EV-onttrekking als de batterij hieronder zakt (veiligheid).
nl.setting_help_resume_soc: Batterij moet dit SOC bereiken voordat EV-ondersteuning hervat na een stop.

nl.config_overview_help: Alles hieronder is direct bewerkbaar. Open HA-instellingen alleen als een sectie de entiteitskiezer mist die je nodig hebt.
nl.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV-laadpalen worden toegevoegd via HA-instellingen zodat SEM hun entiteiten kan registreren. Keer hierna terug om ze fijn af te stellen.
nl.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Prognosegestuurde nachtelijke laadplannen. Stel capaciteit, maximaal laadvermogen en retourefficiëntie in via HA-instellingen — doelwaarden worden automatisch aangepast zodra ingeschakeld.
nl.config_forecast_install_hint: Installeer Forecast.Solar of Solcast in HA om prognosegestuurd plannen in te schakelen.
nl.config_notifications_intro: SEM verstuurt pushmeldingen via je mobile_app-integratie. Kies welke gebeurtenissen je wilt en het ontvangende apparaat via HA-instellingen.
nl.config_help_observer_mode: Alleen-lezen modus: SEM bewaakt je systeem maar stuurt geen opdrachten. Veilig in te schakelen terwijl je het systeem leert kennen.
nl.config_help_update_interval: Seconden tussen coördinatorcycli. Lager = responsiever, hoger = lichter voor HA. 30 s is het optimum.
nl.config_help_power_delta: Minimale vermogensschommeling (W) voordat SEM reageert. Filtert zonne/verbruiksruis weg.
nl.config_help_current_delta: Minimale stroomwijziging voordat SEM de laadpaal bijwerkt. Voorkomt microaanpassingen die contactoren slijten.
nl.config_help_soc_delta: Minimale SOC-wijziging (%) voordat SEM het als een nieuwe toestand beschouwt.
nl.config_help_min_solar_power: Onder dit zonne-uitgangsvermogen (W) stopt SEM met overschotladen — zelfs minimale PV-opbrengst ligt dan onder de ruisgrens.
nl.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Het zonne-overschot moet dit aantal seconden aanhouden voordat overschotladen start. Voorkomt dat één zonnepiek de contactor sluit.
nl.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Het tekort moet dit aantal seconden aanhouden voordat overschotladen stopt; intussen houdt de lader zijn minimumstroom aan. Beschermt de contactor tegen aan/uit-cycli door wolkenflikkering.
nl.onboarding_banner_title: Nieuw: SEM configureren vanuit het dashboard
nl.onboarding_banner_body: Het tabblad Configuratie brengt elke instelling één klik dichterbij — niet meer zoeken via Instellingen → Apparaten & diensten.
nl.config_heat_pump_intro: Kies de relais/klimaatentiteit die je warmtepomp aanstuurt. Wijzigingen worden direct opgeslagen — SEM detecteert de warmtepomp automatisch.
nl.config_help_hp_relay: Voor SG-Ready-installaties: beide relais moeten worden ingesteld. Sla over als je warmtepomp alleen een klimaatentiteit biedt.
nl.config_help_hp_climate: Voor klimaat-only installaties (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM verhoogt het setpoint met de boostoffset °C wanneer er overschot is.
nl.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optioneel — laat SEM het warmtepompverbruik meenemen in verbruiksregistratie en besparingen.
nl.config_help_hp_boost_offset: Hoeveel °C boven het gebruikerssetpoint SEM het klimaatdoel verhoogt bij beschikbaar overschot.
nl.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absoluut maximum voor het klimaatsetpoint — SEM gaat hier niet overheen, ook niet bij ruim overschot.
nl.config_help_hp_priority: Lager = hogere prioriteit. EV krijgt meestal 1-3; warmtepomp 4-6; zwembad 7-10.
nl.config_tariff_class_percentile: Percentiel (relatief aan de prijzen van vandaag)
nl.config_help_tariff_mode: Statisch = één vaste prijs. Dynamisch = haalt uurprijzen op uit je tariefensor. Kalender = geplande HT/NT-vensters.
nl.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: De prijssensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM leest het prognose-attribuut uit.
nl.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Afzonderlijke prognose-sensor als je provider die beschikbaar stelt (Nordpool morgen, Octopus Agile komende 24u).
nl.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Teruglevertariefensor — de vergoeding die je ontvangt bij export. Optioneel.
nl.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentiel past zich aan het werkelijke tariefbereik aan; statisch gebruikt je goedkoop/duur-drempels letterlijk.
nl.config_help_import_rate: Prijs per kWh die je betaalt bij import op het hoog-tarief.
nl.config_help_off_peak_rate: Prijs per kWh tijdens het dalvenster (NT).
nl.config_help_export_rate: Vergoeding per kWh die je ontvangt bij export naar het net.
nl.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Maandelijks capaciteitstarief per kW van je netbeheerder (de 15-minuten piekboete).
nl.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optionele override als SEM de netimportsensor niet automatisch kan selecteren uit je Energiedashboard.
nl.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optionele override als SEM de netexportsensor niet automatisch kan selecteren uit je Energiedashboard.
nl.config_help_bs_enabled: Wanneer ingeschakeld, laadt SEM de batterij 's nachts voor op basis van verwachte tekorten.
nl.config_help_bs_capacity: Bruikbare batterijcapaciteit in kWh — gebruikt om voorlaaddoelen te berekenen.
nl.config_help_bs_max_charge: Maximaal laadvermogen van de batterij in W — begrenst de nachtelijke laadstroom.
nl.config_help_bs_efficiency: Retourefficiëntie van de opslag (0,9 = 10% verlies per laad/ontlaadcyclus).
nl.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: Kosten van batterijslijtage per opgeslagen kWh. Stel in op 0 als je SEM geen cycluspenalty wilt laten berekenen.
nl.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Uur waarop SEM begint met plannen van het nachtelijke vorladen.
nl.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximale SOC waarnaar SEM vorladen (laat ruimte voor zonne-energie in de ochtend).
nl.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimaal verwacht tekort voordat SEM überhaupt begint met vorladen.
nl.config_help_bs_pessimism: Hoe conservatief SEM de prognose interpreteert. 0 = vertrouw de prognose; 1 = ga altijd uit van het slechtste.
nl.config_help_bs_force_neg: Wanneer het dynamische tarief negatief wordt, laad de batterij ook zonder verwacht tekort.
nl.config_help_bs_replan_interval: Hoe vaak de rolling-horizon planner het nachtlaadplan herberekent (verwerkt prijsupdates en prognosewijzigingen).
nl.config_help_bs_block_mode: Kies het goedkoopste aaneengesloten prijsvenster in plaats van verspreide goedkoopste slots — iets hogere kosten, minder omvormer start/stop-cycli.
nl.config_help_lm_enabled: Wanneer ingeschakeld, schakelt SEM niet-kritieke verbruikers af om het netverbruik onder het doelpiekvermogen te houden.
nl.config_help_lm_target_peak: Netverbruik in kW dat je niet wilt overschrijden. SEM behandelt dit als zachte bovengrens.
nl.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW waarbij SEM afschakelbare apparaten vraagt hun verbruik te verminderen.
nl.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Harde kW-bovengrens. SEM schakelt alle afschakelbare apparaten uit op dit niveau.
nl.config_help_lm_critical_protection: Wanneer ingeschakeld, worden als kritiek gemarkeerde apparaten nooit afgeschakeld (bijv. dialyse, serverrack).
nl.config_help_notif_charger: Pushmeldingen voor individuele laadpalen (start, stop, doel bereikt
nl.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Klembord schrijven mislukt — selecteer de tekst handmatig.
nl.config_hot_water_intro: Configureer je warmwaterboiler zodat SEM deze kan boosten op zonne-surplus en periodieke legionellacycli kan uitvoeren.
nl.config_help_hw_entity: Een schakelaar of water_heater-entiteit die SEM aan/uit kan schakelen om de boiler aan te sturen. Verplicht.
nl.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optioneel. Indien geconfigureerd blokkeert SEM het verwarmen zodra de temperatuur het actieve doel bereikt. Laat leeg om alleen op de interne thermostaat van de boiler te vertrouwen.
nl.config_help_hw_solar_target: Afkaptemperatuur voor zonne-boost. SEM stopt met de boiler activeren op surplus wanneer het water deze temperatuur bereikt.
nl.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware-veiligheidsplafond. SEM activeert nooit boven deze temperatuur, ongeacht de modus.
nl.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Doeltemperatuur voor de periodieke legionella-sterilisatiecyclus. Doorgaans 60–65 °C.
nl.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Hieronder dwingt SEM verwarming af vanuit elke bron (niet alleen zonne-energie) om bruikbaar warm water te garanderen.
nl.config_help_hw_priority: Surplusverdeling prioriteit. Lagere nummers worden eerst bediend. 1 = hoogste prioriteit.
nl.battery_mode_hint_auto: Auto: SEM laadt uit zonne-overschot, voedt het huis en volgt het schema.
nl.battery_mode_hint_self_consumption: Laadt uit overschot en voedt het huis — verkoopt nooit aan het net.
nl.battery_mode_hint_force_charge: Laadt nu vol, ongeacht prijs of overschot.
nl.battery_mode_hint_force_discharge: Ontlaadt nu naar het net, tot de reserve-SOC.
nl.battery_mode_hint_off: SEM blijft eraf — de omvormer beheert deze batterij zelf.
nl.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Inschakelen als de ontlaadvermogen-entiteit van deze batterij een bidirectionele instelwaarde is — één number-entiteit voor zowel laden als ontladen, bijv. een Sessy. SEM laadt dan door er een negatieve waarde naar te schrijven. Uit laten voor een eenrichtings geforceerde-ontlaadentiteit (bijv. Huawei).
nl.config_help_strategy_entity: De select-entiteit die de vermogensstrategie van de batterij instelt (bijv. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM zet deze op de API/actieve waarde terwijl het de instelwaarde aanstuurt en herstelt daarna je normale modus (nom/roi/eco). Nodig voor AC-gekoppelde batterijen zoals Sessy; laat anders leeg.

cs.tile_help_consumption: Průměrná spotřeba pro odhad dojezdu z SoC.

cs.config_tab_subtitle: Tune SEM without leaving the dashboard
cs.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
cs.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.
cs.config_tariff_manage: Tariff entity & mode in HA settings
cs.config_heat_pump_manage: Heat pump entities in HA settings
cs.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
cs.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
cs.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
cs.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
cs.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
cs.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
cs.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
cs.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
cs.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
cs.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Solární přebytek musí trvat tolik sekund, než se spustí nabíjení z přebytku. Zabraňuje tomu, aby jediný sluneční výkyv sepnul stykač.
cs.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Deficit musí trvat tolik sekund, než se nabíjení z přebytku zastaví; mezitím nabíječka drží minimální proud. Chrání stykač před cyklováním zap/vyp při proměnlivé oblačnosti.
cs.onboarding_banner_title: New: configure SEM from the dashboard
cs.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
cs.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
cs.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
cs.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
cs.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
cs.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
cs.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
cs.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
cs.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
cs.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
cs.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
cs.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
cs.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
cs.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
cs.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
cs.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
cs.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
cs.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
cs.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
cs.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
cs.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
cs.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
cs.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
cs.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
cs.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
cs.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
cs.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
cs.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
cs.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
cs.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
cs.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
cs.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
cs.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
cs.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
cs.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.

cs.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.

da.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
da.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
da.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
da.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
da.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
da.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.

da.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
da.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
da.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
da.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
da.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
da.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
da.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
da.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
da.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
da.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
da.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.

da.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
da.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
da.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
da.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
da.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
da.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
da.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
da.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
da.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
da.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
da.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
da.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
da.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
da.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
da.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
da.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
da.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
da.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.

fi.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.

fi.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
fi.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
fi.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
fi.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
fi.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
fi.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
fi.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
fi.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Aurinkoylijäämän on kestettävä näin monta sekuntia ennen kuin ylijäämälataus alkaa. Estää yksittäistä aurinkopiikkiä sulkemasta kontaktoria.
fi.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Alijäämän on kestettävä näin monta sekuntia ennen kuin ylijäämälataus pysähtyy; sillä välin latauspiste pitää minimivirtansa. Suojaa kontaktoria pilvivälkkeen aiheuttamalta päälle/pois-syklitykseltä.
