fi.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
fi.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
fi.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
fi.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
fi.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
fi.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
fi.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
fi.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
fi.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
fi.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
fi.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
fi.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
fi.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
fi.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
fi.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
fi.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
fi.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
fi.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
fi.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
fi.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
fi.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
fi.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
fi.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
fi.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
fi.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
fi.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
fi.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
fi.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
fi.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
fi.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
fi.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
fi.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
fi.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
fi.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
fi.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
fi.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
fi.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
fi.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
fi.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
fi.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
fi.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
fi.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
fi.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
fi.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
fi.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
fi.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
fi.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
fi.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
fi.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
fi.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
fi.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
fi.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
fi.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
fi.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
fi.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
fi.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

hu.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
hu.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
hu.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
hu.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
hu.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
hu.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
hu.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
hu.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
hu.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
hu.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
hu.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
hu.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
hu.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
hu.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
hu.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
hu.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
hu.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
hu.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
hu.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
hu.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
hu.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
hu.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
hu.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
hu.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
hu.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
hu.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
hu.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
hu.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
hu.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
hu.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
hu.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
hu.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
hu.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
hu.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
hu.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
hu.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
hu.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
hu.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
hu.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
hu.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
hu.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
hu.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
hu.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
hu.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
hu.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
hu.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
hu.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
hu.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
hu.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
hu.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
hu.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
hu.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
hu.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.

pl.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
pl.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.
pl.config_tariff_manage: Tariff entity & mode in HA settings
pl.config_heat_pump_manage: Heat pump entities in HA settings
pl.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
pl.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
pl.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
pl.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
pl.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
pl.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
pl.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
pl.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
pl.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
pl.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Nadwyżka słoneczna musi utrzymywać się przez tyle sekund, zanim rozpocznie się ładowanie z nadwyżki. Zapobiega zamknięciu stycznika przez pojedynczy skok słońca.
pl.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Deficyt musi utrzymywać się przez tyle sekund, zanim ładowanie z nadwyżki się zatrzyma; w tym czasie ładowarka utrzymuje prąd minimalny. Chroni stycznik przed cyklami wł./wył. przy zmiennym zachmurzeniu.
pl.onboarding_banner_title: New: configure SEM from the dashboard
pl.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
pl.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
pl.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
pl.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
pl.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
pl.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
pl.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
pl.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
pl.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
pl.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
pl.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
pl.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
pl.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
pl.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
pl.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
pl.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
pl.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
pl.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
pl.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
pl.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
pl.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
pl.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
pl.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
pl.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
pl.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
pl.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
pl.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
pl.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
pl.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
pl.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
pl.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
pl.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
pl.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
pl.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
pl.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
pl.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
pl.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
pl.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
pl.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
pl.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
pl.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
pl.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
pl.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
pl.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
pl.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
pl.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
pl.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
pl.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
pl.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
pl.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
pl.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
pl.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
pl.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
pl.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
pl.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
pl.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

pt.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
pt.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
pt.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
pt.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
pt.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
pt.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
pt.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
pt.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
pt.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
pt.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
pt.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
pt.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
pt.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
pt.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
pt.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
pt.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
pt.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
pt.config_help_grid_import_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid import sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
pt.config_help_grid_export_entity: Optional override if SEM can't auto-pick the grid export sensor from your Energy Dashboard.
pt.config_help_bs_enabled: When on, SEM pre-charges the battery overnight ahead of forecasted deficits.
pt.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
pt.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
pt.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
pt.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
pt.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
pt.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
pt.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
pt.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
pt.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
pt.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
pt.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
pt.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
pt.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
pt.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
pt.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
pt.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
pt.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
pt.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
pt.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
pt.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
pt.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
pt.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
pt.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
pt.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
pt.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
pt.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
pt.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
pt.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
pt.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
pt.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
pt.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
pt.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
pt.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
pt.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
pt.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
pt.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

ro.config_help_bs_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh — used to size pre-charge targets.
ro.config_help_bs_max_charge: Max battery charge power in W — caps overnight charging current.
ro.config_help_bs_efficiency: Roundtrip storage efficiency (0.9 = lose 10% per charge/discharge cycle).
ro.config_help_bs_cycle_cost: How much one stored kWh costs in battery wear. Set to 0 if you don't want SEM to penalise cycles.
ro.config_help_bs_trigger_hour: Hour of day SEM starts planning the overnight pre-charge.
ro.config_help_bs_max_target_soc: Maximum SOC SEM will pre-charge to (leave headroom for solar in the morning).
ro.config_help_bs_min_deficit: Minimum forecasted deficit before SEM bothers pre-charging at all.
ro.config_help_bs_pessimism: How conservative SEM's forecast interpretation is. 0 = trust forecast; 1 = always assume worse.
ro.config_help_bs_force_neg: When dynamic tariff goes negative, fill the battery even without a deficit.
ro.config_help_bs_replan_interval: How often the rolling-horizon scheduler re-evaluates the night charge plan (picks up price updates and forecast changes).
ro.config_help_bs_block_mode: Pick the cheapest contiguous price window instead of scattered cheapest slots — slightly higher cost, less inverter start/stop cycling.
ro.config_help_lm_enabled: When on, SEM sheds non-critical loads to keep grid draw under the target peak.
ro.config_help_lm_target_peak: Grid kW you want to stay under. SEM treats this as the soft ceiling.
ro.config_help_lm_warning_peak: kW at which SEM starts asking sheddable devices to reduce.
ro.config_help_lm_emergency_peak: Hard kW ceiling. SEM forces every sheddable device off at this level.
ro.config_help_lm_critical_protection: When on, devices marked critical are never shed (e.g. dialysis, server rack).
ro.config_help_notif_charger: Push notifications for individual chargers (start, stop, target reached, etc.).
ro.config_help_notif_mobile: Master switch — when off, SEM never sends mobile notifications regardless of service config.
ro.config_help_notif_service: Which mobile_app service receives push notifications. Pick the device you want to be paged on.
ro.config_ev_add_remove: Add / remove charger in HA settings
ro.config_help_ev_connected_sensor: Sensor that goes on when an EV is physically plugged into this charger.
ro.config_help_ev_charging_power: Live power draw of this charger. Used for surplus calculation + session tracking.
ro.config_help_ev_current_control: The number entity SEM writes amperage to (or pair with a service in HA settings).
ro.config_help_ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle SOC sensor (Tronity / Bouncie / brand integration). Lets SEM stop at full.
ro.config_help_ev_target_type: kWh mode (default): SEM charges until your daily kWh target is reached. SOC mode: SEM charges until the vehicle SOC reaches your target — only available when a vehicle SOC sensor is configured above.
ro.config_diagnose_clipboard_failed: Clipboard write failed — select the text manually.
ro.config_hot_water_intro: Configure your hot-water boiler so SEM can boost it on solar surplus and run a periodic Legionella cycle.
ro.config_help_hw_entity: A switch or water_heater entity SEM can toggle on/off to drive the boiler. Required.
ro.config_help_hw_temp_sensor: Optional. When configured, SEM blocks heating once the temperature reaches the active target. Leave empty to trust the boiler's internal thermostat only.
ro.config_help_hw_solar_target: Solar-boost cutoff temperature. SEM stops activating the boiler on surplus when the water reaches this.
ro.config_help_hw_max_temperature: Hardware safety ceiling. SEM never activates above this regardless of mode.
ro.config_help_hw_legionella_target: Target temperature for the periodic Legionella sterilisation cycle. Typically 60–65 °C.
ro.config_help_hw_min_temperature: Below this, SEM force-heats from any source (not just solar) to ensure usable hot water.
ro.config_help_hw_priority: Surplus-dispatch priority. Lower numbers are served first. 1 = highest priority.
ro.config_help_battery_bidirectional: Enable if this battery's discharge-power entity is a bidirectional setpoint — one number entity for both charge and discharge, e.g. a Sessy. SEM then charges by writing a negative value to it. Leave off for a one-way forcible-discharge entity (e.g. Huawei).
ro.config_help_strategy_entity: The select entity that sets the battery's power strategy (e.g. select.sessy_*_power_strategy). SEM switches it to the API/active value while it drives the setpoint and restores your normal mode (nom/roi/eco) afterward. Needed for AC-coupled batteries like Sessy; leave empty otherwise.

sv.config_overview_help: Everything below is editable in place. Open HA settings only if a section is missing the entity-picker you need.
sv.config_ev_add_via_settings: EV chargers are added via HA settings so SEM can register their entities. After adding one, return here to fine-tune.

sv.config_battery_scheduler_intro: Forecast-driven overnight charging plans. Configure capacity, max charge power and roundtrip efficiency in HA settings — runtime targets adjust automatically once enabled.
sv.config_forecast_install_hint: Install Forecast.Solar or Solcast in HA to enable forecast-aware planning.
sv.config_notifications_intro: SEM sends push notifications via your mobile_app integration. Pick which events you want, and the recipient device, in HA settings.
sv.config_help_observer_mode: Read-only mode: SEM watches your system but sends no commands. Safe to enable while learning the system.
sv.config_help_update_interval: Seconds between coordinator cycles. Lower = more responsive, higher = lighter on HA. 30 s is the sweet spot.
sv.config_help_power_delta: Minimum power swing (W) before SEM reacts. Filters out solar/load jitter.
sv.config_help_current_delta: Minimum amperage change before SEM updates the charger. Prevents micro-adjustments that wear contactors.
sv.config_help_soc_delta: Minimum SOC change (%) before SEM treats it as a new state.
sv.config_help_min_solar_power: Below this solar output (W), SEM stops surplus charging — even tiny PV is below the noise floor.
sv.config_help_ev_enable_delay: Solöverskottet måste bestå så här många sekunder innan en överskottsladdning startar. Hindrar att en enstaka soltopp stänger kontaktorn.
sv.config_help_ev_disable_delay: Underskottet måste bestå så här många sekunder innan en överskottsladdning stoppas; under tiden håller laddaren sin minimiström. Skyddar kontaktorn mot av/på-cykler vid molnflimmer.

sv.onboarding_banner_body: The Configuration tab puts every setting one click away — no more digging through Settings → Devices & Services.
sv.config_heat_pump_intro: Pick the relays/climate entity that drive your heat pump. Changes save instantly — SEM will pick the heat pump up automatically.
sv.config_help_hp_relay: For SG-Ready setups: both relays must be set. Skip if your heat pump only exposes a climate entity.
sv.config_help_hp_climate: For climate-only setups (Nibe, Mitsubishi, Daikin): SEM raises the setpoint by boost-offset °C when surplus is available.
sv.config_help_hp_power_sensor: Optional — lets SEM include heat-pump draw in load tracking and savings.
sv.config_help_hp_boost_offset: How many °C above the user setpoint SEM lifts the climate target when surplus is available.
sv.config_help_hp_max_setpoint: Absolute ceiling for the climate setpoint — SEM won't push past this even with abundant surplus.
sv.config_help_hp_priority: Lower = higher priority. EV usually gets 1-3; heat pump 4-6; pool 7-10.
sv.config_help_tariff_mode: Static = one fixed price. Dynamic = pulls hourly prices from your tariff sensor. Calendar = scheduled HT/NT windows.
sv.config_help_dynamic_tariff_entity: The price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, aWATTar, Amber, Octopus). SEM reads its forecast attribute.
sv.config_help_dynamic_forecast_entity: Separate forecast sensor if your provider exposes it (Nordpool tomorrow, Octopus Agile next 24h).
sv.config_help_dynamic_feedin_entity: Feed-in price sensor — paid to you when exporting. Optional.
sv.config_help_tariff_class_mode: Percentile adapts to your tariff's actual range; static uses your cheap/expensive thresholds verbatim.
sv.config_help_import_rate: Per-kWh price you pay when importing on the high-tariff side.
sv.config_help_off_peak_rate: Per-kWh price during the off-peak window (NT).
sv.config_help_export_rate: Per-kWh credit you receive when exporting to the grid.
sv.config_help_demand_charge_rate: Monthly per-kW demand charge from your DSO (the 15-min peak penalty).
